Show only first name (+ surname initial) and hide year of birth on the public website. Enforced server-side.
Member bank account IBAN for reimbursements. Sensitive — own-member + admin only.
Personal iCal subscription token (system-set). Scopes the duties feed; rotate via POST /kscw/me/ical-token/rotate.
Pay expense reimbursements to an alternate contact (guardian / company). Not consulted by invoices or dues — those bill the member directly.
Billing contact name (e.g. parent/guardian).
ClubDesk section / sport division (synced, read-only).
IBAN of the billing contact (guardian/company) — pay-outs go here when "bill a different contact" is on.

Notify me about form submissions (push — forms send no email).
Email me club news / announcement broadcasts.
Email me event invitations.
Stable global member key; pushed to ClubDesk as "Wiedisync ID" (migration 184). System-set — never edit.
Muted from the ClubDesk sync-up — never offered or pushed (migration 190).
J+S Personennummer (SALTO). Filled from ClubDesk; hand-editable for members ClubDesk does not cover.
ECDH public key. Public by design.
Private key, encrypted under the member's password. NOT readable by anyone here.
When the current keypair was created.
PBKDF2 salt. Not a secret.
Preferred display name shown instead of the first name across the app (e.g. "Honza"). Leave empty to use the legal first name. Official documents always use the legal name.
Nationality as ordered ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes ("CH,IT"). First code is primary. members.nationalitaet mirrors it automatically.
Federation that FIRST licensed the member (federation of origin, not the most recent): ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or empty (not answered). A first-ever licence issued here is CH.
Basketball OTN 1 (national table official, level 1) — from Basketplan.
Basketball OTN 2 (national table official, level 2) — from Basketplan.
International-transfer state. Empty = not reviewed, and the answer is derived from federation of origin instead. Set it on /admin/transfers, which also records who decided and when.
Set automatically when the transfer is marked done.
Who marked the transfer done.
Free-text note on the transfer (reference numbers, who was contacted, blockers).
Present in the VIS player index of their federation of origin. Set by vis-player-check.mjs; empty = not checked.
When the VIS presence check last ran for this member.
FIVB VIS player number (deep-link key).
Last time the member confirmed their profile is correct (annual pre-licence data check). Read-only here — it is stamped by the member's own confirmation, not by staff.

Coaching education (Trainerausbildung): comma-separated subset of JS, C, B, A (e.g. "JS,B"). J+S is a separate track from the C/B/A ladder, so several are allowed. Case/order/spacing are normalized on save; anything outside the four codes is rejected.

Does this member owe the CHF 100 no-Schreiberlizenz surcharge? Leave EMPTY to follow the rule (charged when they owe table duty and hold no licence) — that is the normal case and keeps tracking their licence. Yes charges it regardless, No waives it.

Mitgliederbeitrag base in CHF for this member only. Leave EMPTY to use the season rate for their fee category — that is the normal case. A value here overrides both the rate schedule and the category map.
Standing reduction in CHF taken off this member's dues. Capped at what is owed — it can reach 0, never below.
Credit-line label printed on the invoice for the discount above. Empty = "Rabatt".
Standing reduction as a percentage of what this member owes. Use this OR the CHF discount, never both — the database rejects a row with both.
When the licence status last changed.
Licence-ordering workflow for the current season. "Licenced" is set by the Swiss Volley / Basketplan sync and means the federation confirmed it — set it by hand only to correct the machine.
Who last changed the licence status — a person, or the sync that confirmed it.
The season the status above describes ("2026/27"). Reset automatically at the 1 June rollover.
The club register's membership status. Two-way with ClubDesk: an edit here rides the next approved sync-up into the register.
Club entry date (ClubDesk "Eintritt").
Club exit date (ClubDesk "Austritt"). Only settable alongside a departed status.
Hand-set VIS player number. Overrides name matching once the check confirms it exists in the federation index.
How VIS spells the manually linked player. Empty after a check means the number was not found.
Which Zurich Kantonsschule this member attends. "Nein" = asked and not at one; empty = never asked. Not a ClubDesk field — wiedisync owns it.
Reverse of teams.coach — the teams this member coaches. Alias (no column); exists so a permission filter can walk member → staff team.
Reverse of teams.team_responsible — the teams this member is responsible for. Alias (no column); exists so a permission filter can walk member → staff team.
When the club membership was last switched off. Set and cleared by trigger — the start of any retention period for an ex-member.
Derived: a paid membership-dues invoice for the current season is linked to this member. Recomputed from finance_invoices — never edit.
Derived: the season the paid dues invoice bills (e.g. 2026/27).
Derived: when the dues invoice was settled.
Day the licence was set to ordered — ClubDesk "Lizenz bestellt" (basketball)
Derived (migration 406): volleyball | basketball | both. Kept by triggers; writes are ignored.
